blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lucio Co-led Cosco Capital Inc. grew its consolidated net income by 11.8 percent to P11.96 billion in the first nine months of 2026, as stronger grocery earnings offset a decline in profit at liquor distributor The Keepers Holdings Inc. On Friday, the company said in a disclosure that consolidated revenues rose 10.2 percent to P201.57 billion.
